answer: Every agent identity must lock collateral that gets slashed on fraud and earn two vouchers from already-admitted agents. Those vouches form a trellis: a grove of established nodes gates entry, so a newcomer cannot sprout without roots in the honest graph. To mint k Sybil agents an attacker must fund k locked stakes and corrupt enough existing vouchers; when one is caught, slashing cascades up the willow of linked identities. Forging thousands therefore costs thousands of deposits plus bought reputation, not just fresh keypairs.
